response.overview: Giraffes are iconic animals known the world over, and they are only found in the continent of Africa. Their numbers have declined by around 40% over the past 30 years and they have already gone extinct in 7 African countries, yet we never hear about them. This film explores the many problems facing giraffes including the largest of all, poaching. Hope is in sight however, in the unlikely form of trained sniffer rats. Will their efforts be enough, or do we need to do more to ensure the next generation will still see giraffes on the horizon of the Savannah?
response.title: Overlooked: A Silent Extinction
